assumptions.b: Every current consumer either dedups on an idempotency key or is naturally idempotent.
assumptions.n: If this falls, the design gains an exactly-once ledger in the hot path and most of the simplicity argument goes with it.

assumptions.b: A job must survive the loss of any one machine. Multi-region durability is out of scope for v1.

decisions.r: One file per tenant, one table per queue. Tenants never share a WAL.
decisions.x: Rejected one shared file (cross-tenant flush coupling) and one file per queue (thousands of open files).

decisions.r: Long-poll HTTP chosen for dispatch; every worker runtime already speaks it.

open.t: Confirm A1 with every consuming team, in writing.
Measure enqueue and dispatch latency under 1k concurrent producers.
